items.title: The United Nations reports that the Tatmadaw's army has killed over 700 Myanmar civilians in six months.
A magnitude 6.1 earthquake strikes Khost, Afghanistan, killing at least 1,000 people and injuring at least 1,500 others.
Russia reports 546 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of deaths since February 11, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 130,347.
Over 200 die of heatstroke in Pakistan's Karachi over the weekend in a record heatwave.
